correctness.rationale: The fixed elliptic cubic E:y²z=x³−xz² is smooth and supersingular in characteristic19. The double cover defined by w²=xy+tz² has six simple branches exactly for t ≠0 and t⁴ ≠12; Riemann–Hurwitz gives genus4. Independently expanded the complete-intersection defining forms to exponent18 over F19 and extracted all sixteen Hasse–Witt coefficient-polynomials using the e_i exponents; matrix matches displayed two-row four-column support. Its sole potential 2x2 block has determinant −8t^6(t⁴−6)(t⁴−7). On the smooth locus rank is 2 outside eight simple roots and 1 at them, so a-numbers 2 and 3. At prime-field roots t=9,7, rank-one blocks have nonzero trace 1,4, hence stable Frobenius rank1; t↦−it fourth-root symmetry transfers to all eight geometric roots. Else block invertible and stable rank2. The universal geometric classification uses symbolic polynomials/isomorphism, not finite F19 sample extrapolation.
